dog.description_text:
There’s something lucky about meeting a puppy like Clover.

Mostly white with the sweetest little black patches decorating her ears, Clover has a look that is entirely her own. Those dark ears give her an especially adorable expression, as if she’s always listening closely for the next adventure - or waiting to hear someone say, “Who wants a cuddle?”

Clover was brought to ARF after being rescued from Louisiana, thanks to our rescue partner BISSELL, and she’s discovering the joys of puppyhood one day at a time, from playful explorations to cozy moments spent soaking up attention.

One look at this precious girl and you may just feel like you’ve found your lucky four-leaf clover.
